task: Restore exact indexed READ authority for imported generic Vector expressions in conditional contexts.
observation: The source-free checker accepted the imported generic `items[i]` condition, but native build failed because the checked generic body had no specialized indexed-expression READ authority. The checker does revisit the imported body under the selected closed specialization, while EST type facts remain keyed to the generic template context; looking only in those EST facts therefore misses the checker-known closed types.
impact: Using the exact specialized ownership environment for receiver, selector, and result TypeRefs, while anchoring the record to the EST Index ExprId, condition statement, receiver binding, and selected specialization, lets native lowering retain a borrowed place without a copy fallback. The focused source-free gate tests both compiler and native consumer fact corruption in Default and EST-shadow.

resolution.summary: Focused Default/Shadow source-backed and source-free gates pass on the isolated candidate. Fast Debug indexes by returning the shared Value element without independent(); it does not make the native move-versus-borrow lowering choice. The direct moss-opt functional gate passes in Default and EST-shadow with test-only hooks skipped. The hook-bearing X1 v9/v10 and Phase 27 .mossi scripts pass in both modes on moss-dev; on moss-opt they fail only because MOSS_TEST_BUILD hooks are absent. Independent reviews remain pending.
